title: Mind in Motion Older Adults Walking Over Uneven Terrain
description: This dataset comprises multimodal neurophysiological and biomechanical recordings from older adults performing walking tasks over uneven terrain at varying speeds. High-density dual-layer electroencephalography (EEG) was collected alongside neck electromyography (EMG), inertial measurement unit (IMU) acceleration, and ground reaction force measurements. Participants completed two trials per condition lasting three minutes each, with an additional three-minute seated rest baseline. The dataset includes digitized electrode locations for each participant and supports investigation of neural mechanisms underlying locomotor control and balance in aging.
methods_description: Data collection included high-density dual-layer EEG, neck EMG, IMU acceleration, and ground reaction force measurements. Participants performed walking trials over uneven terrain at different speeds, with two repetitions per condition (3 minutes each), plus a 3-minute seated rest trial. Digitized electrode locations are provided for each subject.
